record.original_question: Diaz proved that if Y is a complete subvariety of the moduli space M_g of curves of genus g ≥ 2, then dim Y ≤ g - 2. Is there an analogous dimension bound for the moduli spaces of very general smooth degree-d surfaces in P^3 or of very general smooth complete intersections of type (a, b) in P^4, under appropriate hypotheses?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{M}_g$ denote the (coarse) moduli space of smooth complex projective curves of genus $g\ge 2$. A theorem of Diaz states that every complete subvariety $Y\subset \mathcal{M}_g$ satisfies $\dim Y \le g-2$.

For an integer $d\ge 1$, let $S\mathbb{P}_d$ denote the moduli space of smooth surfaces of degree $d$ in $\mathbb{P}^3$, that is, the geometric quotient of the open locus $U_d\subset \mathbb{P}(H^0(\mathbb{P}^3,\mathcal{O}(d)))$ parametrizing smooth surfaces by the natural action of $\mathrm{PGL}(4,\mathbb{C})$. Similarly, for integers $a,b\ge 1$, let $S\mathbb{P}_{a,b}$ denote the moduli space of smooth complete intersections in $\mathbb{P}^4$ of bidegree $(a,b)$, obtained as the geometric quotient by $\mathrm{PGL}(5,\mathbb{C})$ of the open locus in the appropriate Grassmannian-bundle parametrizing such smooth intersections.

Problem. Under appropriate non-degeneracy hypotheses (for instance, restricting to a very general surface or complete intersection of general type), establish a Diaz-type upper bound on the dimension of any complete subvariety $Y\subset S\mathbb{P}_d$, and likewise on the dimension of any complete subvariety $Y\subset S\mathbb{P}_{a,b}$. Specifically: find an explicit function $\phi(d)$ (resp. $\phi(a,b)$), depending only on the numerical invariants, such that every complete subvariety $Y$ satisfies $\dim Y\le \phi(d)$ (resp. $\dim Y\le \phi(a,b)$), in analogy with Diaz's bound $g-2$ for $\mathcal{M}_g$.
artifact.category_tag: Moduli of surfaces and Diaz-type bounds
artifact.status_search_result: No published source establishes a Diaz-type dimension bound for the moduli spaces of smooth surfaces in P^3 or smooth complete intersections of type (a,b) in P^4. Recent work on "Moduli of surfaces in P^3" (Compositio Math., arXiv:1903.09230) studies these moduli spaces but does not provide such a bound. The question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Moduli of surfaces in P^3
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the moduli space of smooth surfaces of degree d in P^3, but does not establish a Diaz-type bound on dimensions of complete subvarieties.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on moduli of surfaces in P^3 does not contain a Diaz-type complete-subvariety dimension bound.

status_evidence.title: A bound on the dimensions of complete subvarieties of M_g (Diaz)
status_evidence.snippet: Diaz's original bound dim Y <= g-2 for complete subvarieties of the moduli space of curves of genus g.
status_evidence.claim: The analogous statement for surface moduli is the open question being asked.
